sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Ultraflex Systems is a partner for high-performing, digitally printable textiles and substrates with over 40 years of innovation.

Industry: Textiles & Materials Manufacturing · Size: <$50M · Products: VorTex Soft Signage, EcoVantage PVC-Free line, Floorscapes, Wallscapes, Frontlit Media, Backlit Media

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Ultraflex Systems scores 43 of 100 (tier C) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by industry fit (16/30) and event engagement (15/15). Nothing was found for pain-point alignment, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: No durability claims were found in their public copy, so the opening has to establish the problem before the product. Lead with the cost of premature graphic failure rather than with film chemistry.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Drytac (29% similar on media, graphics, film, wall); Mactac (24% similar on media, signage, vinyl, printing); Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (12% similar on digitally, vinyl, graphics, signage). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Pain-point alignment: Each additional durability theme found adds 5 points.
• Flags on the record: size third party estimate
